selection_reason: ARIES/REGULUS is a silicon-proven NPU SoC family for on-device and on-premises multimodal inference spanning vision to LLMs, with unified cross-chip scaling, bound- and distribution-aware mixed-precision quantization and piecewise-linear activation handling, showing near-linear performance scaling and high power/bandwidth efficiency in measurements.
title: 17.3 ARIES and REGULUS: A Unified and Scalable hardware–software co-designed NPU SoC Family for On-Device and On-Premises Multimodal Inference
